title: 64c88ae4/T1: Benchmark container image + fflas-ffpack/M4RI reference harnesses
description:
First task of story `64c88ae4`. Produces the reproducible container image and the reference-library benchmark harnesses. Emits CSV baseline numbers.

## Deliverables

- **`benchmarks/Dockerfile`** — Debian-slim + pinned gcc, OpenBLAS, GMP, Givaro, fflas-ffpack, M4RI. `-O3 -march=native` throughout.
- **`benchmarks/Dockerfile.lock`** — image digest pinned for reproducibility.
- **`benchmarks/run.sh`** — launches the container, captures host info in `benchmarks/host.txt`, runs the reference harnesses, drops CSV.
- **`benchmarks/reference/fflas_bench.cpp`** — invokes fflas-ffpack `fgemm`, PLE, echelon, inv, solve, charpoly on identical seeded matrices for every (field, size) combination from the story.
- **`benchmarks/reference/m4ri_bench.c`** — invokes M4RI matmul on GF(2) matrices (seeded identical to the gf2 side).
- **CSV schema documented** in `benchmarks/README.md` — columns: `(lib, operation, field, m, k, n, rank_regime, seed, wall_ns, throughput_ops)`.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Container builds from a clean state with the pinned Dockerfile.
- [hard] Harnesses run to completion and emit CSV for every (field, op, size) combination listed in the story.
- [hard] Host hardware captured in `host.txt` at run time.
- [hard] Bench seeds are deterministic; rerun produces identical matrices (even if timings differ).
- [hard] Container image works on a host that has *no* fflas-ffpack / M4RI installed natively — i.e., nothing leaks from the host.

## Depends on

- None (can start in parallel with T2).
